decision.reason: All five current Figma Button component sets default Size=Small, and the latest Material Web Small token family agrees with Compose expressive Small on 40px/dp height, 20px/dp icon size, and 16px/dp horizontal spacing. The project has no published compatibility contract yet, so the React default is corrected before release while legacy baseline tokens remain source evidence.

compose.iconSizeTodo: ButtonDefaults.IconSize is hard-coded 18.dp with TODO to update from corrected BaselineButtonTokens; ButtonDefaults.SmallIconSize uses ButtonSmallTokens.IconSize.

materialWeb.disposition: public runtime adapter is legacy-source evidence; latest size family is the current web token reference

canonical.legacyBaselineRole: source-reference fallback for Compose classic / Material Web v0_192 audits, not public React default
